decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct, contradictory assertions regarding Teofila Morawska's spouse. Document 1 (D1) explicitly states in D1S3 and D1S16 that she married Alexander Ivanovich Chernyshev. Document 2 (D2) presents a 'shocking discovery' claiming she was married to Cecil William Donovan (D2S2), despite the chronological impossibility noted within the text itself (born over a century apart). Per the instruction to treat all audits and saved answers as fallible and to preserve separately valid referents without adopting a single interpretation or dismissing contradictions silently, both names are retained as valid answers derived from the source text.
